---
title: "ibm_verify_events_raw.adaptive_access"
description: "One row per IBM Verify adaptive access evaluation."
---

Every IBM Verify adaptive access evaluation: the risk level IBM Verify assigned
to an access attempt, and what its policy did about it. Prefer the daily summary,
[`events_adaptive_risk_summary`](../ibm_verify_events_transformed/events_adaptive_risk_summary.qmd).

`Keywords`: adaptive access, risk, risk level, policy, device, browser, location, bots, raw events

## Provenance

Pulled hourly from IBM Verify by the [streaming
job](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_streaming_etl.py).
See [IBM Verify Events](../ibm_verify_events_raw.qmd) for what is hashed and
how to filter by day.

Data starts on 2026-09-09, when adaptive access went live.

* **Updated**: Hourly
* **Retention**: 3 years
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<raw-bucket>/ibm_verify_events_raw/adaptive_access/`

## Fields

One row per evaluation.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| time | string | When the evaluation happened, in UTC (for example, "2026-09-15 00:00:05 UTC") |
| userid | string | Hashed user ID |
| username | string | Hashed username |
| applicationid | string | IBM Verify's numeric ID for the application being reached |
| applicationname | string | Application name (for example, "IRIS - PRC - Prod") |
| risk_level | string | "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "VERY_HIGH", or empty |
| decision_reason | string | IBM Verify's reason for the rating (for example, "Access from a known and trusted device"). Empty when there is no risk level |
| policy_action | string | What the policy did. Mostly "ACTION_CONTINUE", "ACTION_MFA_PER_SESSION", "ACTION_MFA_ALWAYS", or "ACTION_REDIRECT" |
| policy_id | string | IBM Verify's ID for the access policy |
| policy_name | string | Access policy name (for example, "GCS_AccessPolicies_Default_Migration") |
| browser | string | Browser (for example, "Firefox") |
| os | string | Operating system (for example, "Windows NT") |
| city | string | City from the IP address |
| region | string | Province, territory, or state from the IP address |
| country | string | Country from the IP address, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (for example, "CAN") |
| realm | string | IBM Verify directory, "cloudIdentityRealm" |
| origin | string | Hashed client IP address |
| year | string | Partition key. UTC year, for example "2026" |
| month | string | Partition key. UTC month, for example "09" |
| day | string | Partition key. UTC day of the month, for example "15" |

## Notes

**About 10% of evaluations have no risk level.** Almost all of them have
`policy_action = "ACTION_REDIRECT"`. The summary table counts them in
`total_invocations` but in no level.

**Location columns are named differently here.** They are `city`, `region`, and
`country`, not the `geoip__` columns of the other three tables.

**Example.** Evaluations and distinct users by risk level on an ET day:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_raw", "adaptive_access")) |>
  # partitions are UTC days, so read the next one too for the ET evening
  filter(year == "2026", month == "09", day %in% c("15", "16")) |>
  mutate(et_day = sql("date(with_timezone(CAST(substr(time, 1, 19) AS timestamp), 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')")) |>
  filter(
    et_day == as.Date("2026-09-15"),
    !is.na(userid), !userid %in% c("", "UNKNOWN")
  ) |>
  group_by(risk_level) |>
  summarise(evaluations = n(), unique_users = n_distinct(userid))
```
